subsample_note: Subsampled to 400 of 2504 samples, 80 per superpopulation (AFR/AMR/EAS/EUR/SAS), round-robin across constituent populations, seed=20130502. Column order follows original VCF sample order.
variant_filter: biallelic SNPs (single-base ACGT REF and ALT) with fully phased '|' genotypes in all retained samples
access_method: tabix linear index parsed in pure Python to get a coffset, then an HTTP Range request into the bgzipped VCF and per-BGZF-block raw-deflate decompression; no tabix/bcftools/pysam
license_note: 1000 Genomes Project phase 3 (IGSR/EBI) data are openly available with no restrictions on use. Please cite The 1000 Genomes Project Consortium, 'A global reference for human genetic variation', Nature 526, 68-74 (2015). https://www.internationalgenome.org/data
